label: preparing
what: A community meal/gathering in the great hall at 18:00 on day 1, with community bread; builder and Freight coordinated arrangements with the innkeeper. Neighbour appears to have been told privately and offered to join/help, but the record does not firmly establish that the neighbour knowingly helped prepare it. The mayor was kept uninformed of its nature/arrangements until it was described in the schedule as a community meal; preparation was deliberately not requested of the mayor and details were deferred to the innkeeper.
